claims.statement: The signed factorial-moment error equals the averaged Bonferroni occupancy polynomial minus the averaged model Taylor polynomial.
The absolute RUHL envelope forces |E_1| < Delta/q, which is O(1) in the frozen geometry n_b B asymp X/log X.
In the signed residual, excess first moment helps; the weakest first-order constraint is one-sided after the higher-order signed remainder is retained.
The frozen Heath--Brown identity is exact for n <= z^J and has absolute binomial coefficient mass 2^J-1.
For N~exp(X), H=X^2, forcing z=N^(1/J)<=H requires J~X/(2 log X), producing coefficient mass exp(Theta(X/log X)).
A termwise absolute Heath--Brown proof at the forced cutoff must establish sum_r binom(J,r)|R_r| < Delta.
Coefficient mass alone rules out every termwise absolute implementation.
RUHL-FM, INT-AOD, or Fortune is proved.
